title: 2684. Maximum Number of Moves in a Grid

examples.explanation: We can start at the cell (0, 0) and make the following moves: - (0, 0) -> (0, 1). - (0, 1) -> (1, 2). - (1, 2) -> (2, 3). It can be shown that it is the maximum number of moves that can be made.
Starting from any cell in the first column we cannot perform any moves.
